preconditions.description: The number of destinations n must be between 2 and 100,000.
The number of Time Corridors m must be at least n - 1 and at most 1,000,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a <= n and 1 <= b <= n and a != b and 0 <= e <= 1000000000 for a, b, e in corridors)
preconditions.description: Each corridor must connect two distinct destinations with valid energy requirements.

postconditions.description: The output must be the maximum energy E_max for the first corridor such that it can still be part of a minimum spanning tree.
